# Home Assistant integration for UniFi Drive / UNAS v0.5.0 - Initial Release

Initial public release baseline for the unofficial Home Assistant integration
for compatible UniFi Drive / UNAS devices.

## Highlights

- Local-first Home Assistant custom integration for compatible UniFi Drive /
  UNAS devices.
- Storage health, capacity, throughput, drive temperatures, UniFi OS and Drive
  version sensors, uptime, status, IP addresses, fan mode, updates,
  Wake-on-LAN, backup tasks, and optional snapshot controls.
- Config flow, reconfigure support, options flow, diagnostics, translations,
  entity categories, Home Assistant services, and HACS metadata.
- Conservative local discovery with trusted identity handling for host aliases,
  MAC hints, VLAN and multi-interface observations, conflict diagnostics, and
  reduced repeated setup prompts.
- Startup/reload hardening that preserves cached online data during transient
  startup failures and avoids reloads for discovery metadata-only entry
  updates.
- Explicit legal and asset hygiene documentation for the unofficial project
  status, descriptive compatibility naming, original project artwork, and
  exclusion of official vendor assets or proprietary material.
